subtitle: Welcome back, please sign in to your account

standalone.brandDesc: Sign in with the local admin account to manage 1ONE from your phone or a remote browser.
standalone.introTitle: Built for remote operations and session control
standalone.introText: Securely access your local 1ONE from the browser, keep track of sessions and tasks, and stay productive across devices.
standalone.cardSubtitle: Username and password are in Settings → Remote → WebUI

admin.brandDesc: Sign in with the local WebUI admin account to configure auth, invites, tenants, and governance—separate from the member sign-in entry.
admin.introText: For system and org admins: manage LDAP/Feishu, member invites, edition switches, and admin modules—not for everyday employee use.
admin.cardSubtitle: Use the local admin account from Settings → Remote → WebUI

enterprise.brandDesc: Command-line and conversational AI for teams—with unified accounts and permissions. Supports local, LDAP, and Feishu sign-in.
enterprise.introText: Support multi-tenant governance, LDAP directory integration, and Feishu, DingTalk, or WeCom SSO to deliver a secure and efficient AI workspace.

methods.label: Sign-in method
methods.ldapHint: Sign in with your corporate directory account
methods.localHint: Sign in with a local administrator account
methods.ldapDisabledHint: LDAP is configured but not enabled yet. Ask your organization admin to enable it before using domain login.
methods.oauthPending: {{provider}} OAuth callback is not wired yet. Use LDAP, Feishu, or local sign-in, or join with an invite code after login.

enterpriseRedirectHint: After sign-in you will enter 1ONE Code Enterprise. You can also join an org with an invite code.
providersDisabledHint: Enterprise sign-in methods are configured but not enabled. Ask your org admin to enable LDAP, Feishu, DingTalk, or WeCom under Enterprise console → Authentication.
inviteTitle: Or join with an invite code
inviteCoexist: Invite codes work alongside enterprise sign-in: sign in with any method above (local, LDAP, Feishu, etc.), then open Enterprise and enter your invite code.

errors.invalidLdapCredentials: Invalid domain credentials. Check your username and password, or contact your admin to verify LDAP is enabled.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts, please try again later
errors.serverError: Server error, please try again later
errors.dbUnavailable: Local database is unavailable. Close other 1ONE instances and restart the app, or delete the corrupted database file (see app logs) and try again.
errors.loginUiLoadFailed: Could not load sign-in options. Refresh the page or contact your administrator.
errors.ldapNotEnabled: LDAP sign-in is not enabled yet. Ask your org admin to enable it, or use a local account.
errors.feishuNotEnabled: Feishu sign-in is not enabled yet. Ask your org admin to enable it.
errors.feishuNotConfigured: Feishu SSO is not configured under Admin console → Authentication → Feishu. Note: the Feishu channel bot in Settings is not org sign-in.
errors.feishuConfiguredButDisabled: Feishu is configured but the Enable switch is off, or it conflicts with LDAP/other SSO. Open Admin console → Authentication → Feishu, enable it, and save.
errors.dingtalkNotConfigured: DingTalk SSO is not configured under Admin console → Authentication → DingTalk. Note: the DingTalk channel bot in Settings is not org sign-in.
errors.dingtalkConfiguredButDisabled: DingTalk is configured but the Enable switch is off. Open Admin console → Authentication → DingTalk, enable it, and save.
errors.wecomNotConfigured: WeCom SSO is not configured under Admin console → Authentication → WeCom.
errors.wecomConfiguredButDisabled: WeCom is configured but the Enable switch is off. Open Admin console → Authentication → WeCom, enable it, and save.
errors.oauthNotAvailable: This sign-in method is not available yet. Try another method or contact your admin.
